title: 宝塚記念の後に・再生、そして、脈動

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After running with all she's got and crossing the finish line, Mejiro Dober realizes just how hard her heart is pounding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her racing heart is proof of the strength that brought her victory and the manifestation of her powerful wish to forge a new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having finally found herself, Mejiro Dober once again expresses her desire to race against Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She sets her sights on the next race, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, where she seeks to defeat Air Groove once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But first, we set our sights on the Fuchu Umamusume Stakes!
